findings.message: Braking zones under-measured by one sample step (src/demo/features.js:128-129): detectBrakingZones measured a run first-to-last sample, so a 50 m run read as 40 m and was dropped; runs under 60 m of coverage were missed.
Approval evidence rests on a stub, not a Qodo review (evidence/runs/T-008-2026-11-20T13-30-57-066Z.json:58-61): the T-008 record wrote qodo.available=false next to a bare verdict APPROVED.

diagnose.rootCause: Finding 1: each telemetry sample stands for one 10 m segment starting at its distance, but the code measured span (last - first) instead of covered length (last - first + step). Finding 2: src/factory/index.js computed the verdict from local blockers only and never stated the verdict's basis; the record honestly marked qodo unavailable in three places but the bare APPROVED read as Qodo-backed. Root cause is in src/factory/index.js, NOT under scripts/ — fixed on this branch.

fixFinding1.output: detectBrakingZones now reports endM = min(last sample distance + SAMPLE_STEP_M, LAP_LENGTH_M) and compares the true covered length against the 50 m threshold. Seed-42 zones re-derived from the raw runs (probe: 16 runs, 5 long ones): 320-670, 1610-1960, 2620-2960, 3710-4090, 4800-5160 m — same 5 zones, true ends. 3 new tests: 50 m run detected (fails before, passes after), 40 m run not a zone, seed-42 exact zones. detectDrsZones shares the old pattern — filed as follow-up ticket T-010, NOT changed here (out of scope for PR #5).

fixFinding2.output: Root-cause fix in src/factory/index.js: when Qodo is unavailable the factory now writes approvalBasis ('local checks only ... Qodo review did not run at factory time and is still required on the PR') and qodoReviewPending=true on every run record. T-008 record corrected in place with the same fields plus a correction note; no stage results, outputs, or the verdict value were altered. Proof: factory run on scratch ticket T-999 in a /tmp copy of the fixed tree produced a record carrying approvalBasis + qodoReviewPending=true with qodo.available=false (evidence /tmp/factory-proof/evidence/runs/T-999-2026-11-20T14-42-05-116Z.json — scratch copy, not committed).
